description: S437 round 5 F3: a handler statement carrying a NON-FATAL notice (W-MAP-DUPLICATE-LITERAL-KEY, Info) still lowers from its statement list and runs both statements. Pre-fix the notice was counted as a parse failure: the statement list was dropped and the build failed E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC.
rationale: §59.3: duplicate map-literal keys are last-wins with an Info notice; §5.2.3: no statement of the block SHALL be dropped.
